name: Glossary index
purpose: Opens the glossary page and lets a visitor find a learning term by first letter, then read its short definition.
description: Oldest-system block (fixed 16px root) carrying the page H1: centred serif H1, a multi-line intro and a static email sign-up row; an A-Z pill radio filter ("All" + 26 letters, filters terms by first letter) with a "Showing N results." line; then a 3-column grid (2 at 991, 1 at 767) of rounded #1b1b1b term cards ("What is X?" heading, definition, "Read more" chip). Hovering a card dims the others to 50%.

motion.reducedMotionNote: The schema REQUIRES this fallback on every generated node. Neither the original site nor the clone implements prefers-reduced-motion; this is a generation-time requirement, not a description of the source.
motion.note: Once on scroll-into-view: the header fades in (1s, delay .1s), the filter fades in (1s, start top 80%), the term list rises from y 100 and fades in (1s, delay .5s), all power3.out. Hover: other cards dim to opacity .5 over 500ms and return over 200ms ease; letter pills and Read more chips change colour (.3s / .2s).
